releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.18 refreshes the public product experience with real Drive, Engineer, Setup, and RookForce evidence, and names Asetek Forte as the currently supported RookForce wheelbase.

Desktop feedback no longer reads GitHub, CLI, or AI-provider credentials. Its separate feedback service remains unavailable until its privacy and owner-inbox setup is complete.

The Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies the published combined installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
